selection.source: Phase3.4 frozen 48 main images only; no five historical cases
selection.algorithm: Sort string qid; Random(seed) shuffles left, historical-Full-correct right, historical-Full-wrong right in that order. Take8 left, up to4 each right stratum; fill missing right slots by shuffling sorted remaining right. Return qid sorted.
selection.labels: 8 left / 8 right; right selection uses historical Native Full only, never current interventions

config.gpu_policy: Only physical GPU1; internal cuda:0 and exactly one visible device; no other jobs killed
config.interpretation: 16-image mechanism pilot, not overall accuracy evaluation. No additional conditions, training, physical exit, decoding, new data or causal token deletion claim.
config.denominators: Original raw masses: BOS/Image/Question/other text partition all keys. Sink raw is inside Image; conditional Sink fraction is mean of headwise ratios, separately also ratio of mean masses. Norms never summed across sources.
config.residuals: Attention o_proj output / layer input; MLP output / pre-MLP residual, plus / layer input. Cosines use corresponding actual residual. Hidden layer labels are post-layer, zero-based; final_norm additionally after final RMSNorm.
